subject: [PATCH 1/2] mm: vmscan: allow writeout of swapcache folios without anon mappings

2026-11-06.patch_summary: This patch allows the writeout of swapcache folios without an anonymous mapping, which was previously rejected by pageout(). The change enables reclaim to write out these folios while their swap entries remain referenced. This fix addresses a problem where unfaulted zswap readahead folios could be dirty and in swapcache without an anonymous mapping.

reviews.author: Baolin Wang
reviews.summary: Approved the patch, noting that it addresses an issue where swapcache folios without anonymous mappings are rejected during writeout.
reviews.raw_body:
On 11/7/26 12:04 AM, Nhat Pham wrote:
> Unfaulted zswap readahead folios can be dirty and in swapcache without
> an anonymous mapping. pageout() rejects them before swap_writeout(),
> so reclaim cannot write them out while their swap entries remain
> referenced.
> 
> Allow swapcache folios through the filesystem folio check. They already
> have swap entries and can use the existing swap writeout path. Anonymous
> folios outside swapcache have no mapping and already return PAGE_KEEP.
> 
> Reported-by: Sashiko <sashiko-bot@kernel.org>
> Link: https://lore.kernel.org/all/sashiko-outbox-181078@kernel.org/
> Fixes: 84798514db50 ("mm: Remove swap_writepage() and shmem_writepage()")
> Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
> Signed-off-by: Nhat Pham <nphamcs@gmail.com>
> ---

LGTM.
Reviewed-by: Baolin Wang <baolin.wang@linux.alibaba.com>

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch allows the writeout of swapcache folios without anonymous mappings by modifying the filesystem folio check in mm/vmscan.c. The change enables reclaim to write out dirty and unfaulted zswap readahead folios that are present in swapcache, even if they don't have an anonymous mapping.
